5b15cd35-1352-4909-bf45-99f946d160cc.description:
Havells India Limited 
Center of Research & Innovation (CRI), Bangalore 
https://www.havells.com/ 
 
About Havells: Havells India Ltd is founded in 1958 and it is an Indian Multinational organization in the domains of home appliances, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, LED lighting, fans, modular switches and wiring accessories, water heaters, industrial and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors, and capacitors among others. Havells is an ambitious and forward-looking product organization.  
Job title: AIML Engineer  	Work Location: Bangalore 
Center of Competency: AIML  	Department: AI/ML
Reports to: Lead Research Engineer - AIML  
Full-time 	
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:  
    • As an AIML Engineer, you will develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex business problems.  
    • Use Statistical methods to understand the datasets, draw elementary insights and decide on algorithms. 
    • Perform data pre-processing, feature engineering, and model selection to improve model performance. 
    • Own the end-to-end process of development (conducting experiments for data generation to model development).  
    • Develop metrics relevant for evaluation of model performance.  
    • As a part of R&D group, contribute with the emerging techniques and apply based on the relevance to the business. 
    • Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures. 
Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:  
    • A Graduate / post graduate in STEM with Data Science certification with 1-3 years of relevant experience. 
    • Excellent programming skills in Python, knowledge on various libraries such as TensorFlow, NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Keras and many more.  
    • Hands-on experience on various machine learning algorithms, Deep theoretical knowledge on Time Series Analysis, Forecasting, or Computer Vision (Image Processing, Classification, Detection, Segmentation), or Audio Processing (Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-toSpeech (TTS), Speech-to-Text (STT)). 
    • Should have demonstrated taking at least 1-2 ML model to market/production in previous experience.  
    • Experience working with one or more embedded platforms from Qualcomm, Nvidia, Intel, NXP, ESP, SMT, etc., is a plus. 
    • Must have good verbal and written communication skills, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers. 
Role Overview:  
As an AIML Engineer, you'll play an essential role in the design & development of the product features related to Artificial Intelligence and add significant value with the business proposition. Your contributions will help customers gaining significant value for money and comfort and it will help organization in meeting the customers' expectations.  
Our mission is to integrate cutting-edge IoT, wireless (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi), and cloud computing technologies into practical solutions for electrical and electronics appliance control. As an AIML Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing machine learning and deep learning models to solve complex business challenges. You will work across various domains, including time series analysis, computer vision, and audio processing, to develop state-of-the-art solutions. The role involves end-to-end development, from data preprocessing and model selection to deployment and optimization.

c60616ed-3b08-4ac3-bc0e-d4096e66e643.description:
Job Description for Software Engineer/Senior Software Engineer – Backend engineering - Havells
 
We offer the topics of tomorrow and build a team that wants to work together to make a difference. We are looking for bright minds full of commitment and enthusiasm with experience in building and scaling platform services in a cloud environment. You’ll be responsible for creating, building, and maintaining the platform’s design, development, performance optimization, integration, and deployment activities. This high-growth position is integral to our success and requires a thoughtful and systematic approach. In this role, you will be developing software for the Internet of Things utilizing modern and agile development techniques.

About Havells: Havells is an ambitious and forward-looking product organization that owns Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, REO, and Standard brands with a wide range of products, consumer appliances under each brand. More about Havells at https://www.havells.com/
 
Job Requirements: (ARE & RE)
Must have:
• 3-8 years of meaningful experience building internet-enabled enterprise-class software systems and services
• Very good expertise in algorithms and data structures
• Excellent in at least one of the programming languages and frameworks listed below:
o Most preferred: java script and node js, type script and nest js, python with flask/falcon
o Nice to have: java and springboot, go, rust
• Good understanding of operating systems, networking fundamentals, performance analysis, and optimizations
• Hands-on experience in at least one cloud platform – Azure(preferred), AWS, or GCP
• Hands-on experience in using SQL/NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, definition of data models, query performance analysis, and optimization
• Good understanding of distributed system fundamentals

Nice to have:
• Demonstrated experience with internet-scale cloud-based distributed systems development(end to end), Microservices, databases(RDBMS/NoSQL)
• Working knowledge of the “Internet of Things” desired
• Good understanding of MQTT, WebSockets, Message Queues like Kafka
• Good understanding of new frameworks, platform trends in the space of distributed systems (Incl. Kubernetes, Dockers)
• Working knowledge in Application and services-based security understanding (oauth2, CORS, SQL Injection, etc.)
• Good knowledge of Domain-Driven Design, Test Driven Development
• Hands-on in design patterns, software architecture, system design
• Experience developing in an Agile / SCRUM Environment
Soft skills:
• Self-driven, results-oriented, collaborative, comfortable with a fast-paced, always-on, highly ambiguous start-up like environment
• Good with rapid problem solving, a solid technical background, and a passion for continuous learning and improvement
• Good verbal and written communication skills
